response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced and versatile full-stack software craftsman, but he lacks the mandatory 5-10 years of C++ development experience on the Windows platform required for this role. His C++ experience is limited to a brief 7-month stint in 2014-2015, and his recent background is predominantly in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang rather than the required fixed income or capital markets C++ ecosystem.
strengths: Extensive overall software engineering experience (15+ years) across diverse tech stacks, architectures, and full-stack development.
Strong background in software craftsmanship, including TDD, CI/CD pipelines, and agile methodologies.
Possesses some relevant financial domain exposure through his work at RIDE Capital focusing on investment practices.
concerns: Fails to meet the mandatory requirement of 5-10 years of hands-on C++ development, having only 7 months of professional C/C++ experience from 2014-2015.
Lacks demonstrated experience with C++ on the Windows platform, as his systems experience leans heavily towards Linux, web technologies, and DLang.
Missing deep domain expertise in Fixed Income, Derivatives, or enterprise Capital Markets systems using SQL Server/Oracle.
